# GitHub Metadata

This folder contains GitHub-facing repository metadata and collaboration templates.

## What Lives Here

- issue templates
- pull request template
- future GitHub workflow metadata when explicitly approved

## What Does Not Live Here

- secrets or credentials
- KiCad project source
- local-only backups
- large build artifacts

## Current Repo Context

- Repo visibility: `PRIVATE`
- Public release status: `NOT_READY`
- Active project: `ESP32_CSI_WIFI_NODE`
- Current board status: live PCB exists, but it is not fabrication-ready
